notes.title: Known issue about info view
notes.content:
A new bug was introduced after last updates: If you upgrade your building under info view, some redundant information will be displayed in the screen and they cannot be cleared. We will solve this issue in next update. By now, you can solve this issue by simply restart the game.

The next update will solve the "useless" problem of Decoration Facilities.
